_doc: The menu layer (world v72) — the orderable catalog per door-having venue: what you can actually buy, in game dollars, with availability conditions and the signature item each room is known for. Where storefronts.json is what the sign SAYS, menus.json is what the counter SELLS — machine-readable for the game side's commerce/economy layer and the future order-a-thing request type. Rules: doors only (anchor + street tiers; offstage and reserved carry none); game dollars only — price is a number ≥ 0 or the string "ask" for market-priced/verbal items, never credits, never USD framing; `when` ⊆ storefronts.json when_keys — a conditional item is a CONDITION the shelf reflects, never a scheduled script; exactly the items a stranger could order — no secret stock, no favoritism prices. Board agreement: any menu item named on the venue's storefront board must carry the same price. Spec: world/menus.md; demo: world/menus.html (inline MENUS mirror).

cat_keys.drink: something in a cup or glass
